name: Dante, Hemomancer deals X unpreventable damage to himself and empowers by X
notes: Dante, Hemomancer's own activated ability is champion-identity-gated (a card-ID switch case, not the generic element-lineage system), so the starting champion object's CardID itself is patched directly to Dante, Hemomancer rather than only patching Subcards. Activating it opens a NUMBERCHOOSE for X (answered via the plain numeric cardID '2', per this engine's NUMBERCHOOSE answer convention), then pays X reserve, then a reactive opportunity window (declined via PASS) before the ability deals X unpreventable damage to Dante and empowers him by X. Note: the printed cost is '(X), [REST]:' but the champion's Status remains 2 (awake) after activation -- the engine never rests the champion as part of paying this cost. This is asserted as observed reality (a known gap, separately flagged) rather than treated as a reason to abandon the fixture, since the (X)-cost and damage/empower effects themselves are correctly implemented and are the ability's core testable clause.

rulesClauses: (X), [REST]: Deal X unpreventable damage to Dante and empower X. X can't be 0 or greater than 4.
